First public release of **D110 Studio**, a Tauri 2 label editor for NIIMBOT D110.

- English by default, with a persistent English / Ukrainian language switch.
- Text and image labels, monochrome preview, PNG export, and saved editor settings.
- Bluetooth discovery, connection, printer identification, print progress, and cancellation.
- Native BlueZ on Linux; a shared BLE backend on Windows, macOS, and Android.

### Downloads

Choose the asset matching your operating system and CPU:

| Platform | Architecture | Formats |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Linux | x64, ARM64 | `.deb`, `.rpm`, `.AppImage` |
| Windows | x64 | `.exe` (NSIS), `.msi` (WiX) |
| macOS | Intel x64, Apple Silicon ARM64 | `.dmg` |
| Android 8.0+ | ARM64, x64 emulator | `.apk` |

`SHA256SUMS.txt` contains checksums for all 12 installers.

### Build and device testing

All installers are taken from [successful CI run 38905356636](https://github.com/Rhonstin/niimbot-d110/actions/runs/38905356636), commit `501e737796e9ff22f348eb94ebdb3bbeae0fca00`.

Desktop installers are unsigned and macOS builds are not notarized. Android APKs
are development builds signed with the CI runner's debug key. Bluetooth printing
on Windows, macOS, and Android still needs testing with a physical printer.
